headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential vulnerabilities and improve security. Leverage AI-driven insights for better risk assessment during the installation process. Implement a user-friendly interface that highlights critical issues early in the development cycle.
